boundaries.note: 2026-27 only: the SuperLiga shrinks from 14 to 12, so four clubs (11th-14th) are relegated while the First League promotes only its top two. No play-off in either direction. From 2027-28 this should return to 2 up / 2 down.
boundaries.steady_note: Steady state (2 up / 2 down): the game runs on the database snapshot of 14 clubs and must keep the roster size, so the one-off 2026-27 shrink (4 down / 2 up, 14 to 12) is recorded in this note but not applied. Applying it every season would shrink the league by two clubs a year.

conflicts.topic: Promotion and relegation are not balanced in 2026-27
conflicts.detail: SuperLiga: 14 clubs now, 12 from 2027-28, therefore 4 relegated (11th-14th). First League: still 16 clubs, promoting only 2 champions/runners-up but relegating 6 (11th-16th) to the Srpska liga. Any generic 3-up/3-down assumption is wrong for both levels this season.

SuperLiga splits 6 + 8 (31 vs 33 matches per club); First League splits 6 + 10 (35 vs 39). Points carry over, and the two groups are separate final tables, so 'one table of N clubs' cannot express either league.
SB19 (Omladinska liga Srbije) has no Wikipedia article; our 14 clubs could not be confirmed. Recorded as-is and flagged rather than guessed or nulled.

notes: SER1 is 14 clubs in 2026-27 (16 in 2025-26, 12 from 2027-28); SER2 is 16. Both use a points-carrying split after the double round robin, with unequal group sizes, so clubs play different numbers of matches (31/33 and 35/39). 2026-27 is the transition season with 4 down from level 1 and 2 up, and 6 down from level 2 into the four-group Srpska liga (level 3, not modelled, hence closed_down=true for SER2). No relegation play-offs at either level this season. SB19 is the U19 youth championship of the top two tiers' youth sides: closed both ways, no route into the senior pyramid, size unverified.
